choose.when:
select d.id, ifnull(ds.name_override, d.name) as name, ifnull(ds.image_override, d.image) as image, ifnull(ds.type_id_override, d.typeId) as typeId, d.monthlysale, ifnull(ds.sorting_override, d.sorting) as sorting, ifnull(ds.unitprice, d.unitprice) as unitprice, ifnull(ds.unit_override, d.unit) as unit, d.quantity, ds.stock as stock, d.time, ifnull(ds.onsale_override, d.onsale) as onsale, ds.sold_out as sold_out, ifnull(ds.specification_override, d.specification) as specification, ifnull(ds.serving_duration_override, d.serving_duration_minutes) as serving_duration_minutes from t_dish d inner join t_dish_shop ds on ds.dish_id = d.id and ds.shop_id = #{shop_id} left join t_category c on c.id = ifnull(ds.type_id_override, d.typeId) left join t_category_shop cs on cs.category_id = c.id and cs.shop_id = #{shop_id} order by ifnull(cs.sorting_override, c.sorting) asc, c.id asc, ifnull(ds.sorting_override, d.sorting) asc, d.id asc
limit #{start},#{pageSize}
choose.otherwise:
select d.* from t_dish d left join t_category c on d.typeId = c.id order by c.sorting asc, c.id asc, d.sorting asc, d.id asc
limit #{start},#{pageSize}

mapper.select:
